data.rationale: The proposal has the same steps in the same order (Attractions, type and select destination, pick date, Search, filters/sort, open result, choose tickets) and parameters equivalent to the true ones (ticket counts ≈ guests), but the last step and the filters are vague enough that building the automation would take a little guesswork.
